name: Railan
source:
Prince Railan is the second and forgotten son of the King and Queen of Wildshire. The Prince has locked himself away and now must contend with his brand new servant disrupting his life—and possibly even falling in love with them. He is very guarded and has a defeatist attitude about life, but at his core, he is lonely and looking for someone to give him affection. He has a real soft spot once you get past all of his walls.

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/the-princes-keeper]itch.io[/url]]
